## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. State any rendering or save limits. Cite the ECMA-376 elements and subclauses that the change implements.

## Verification

List commands and results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Release notes

If the change touches a published package, link the changeset. Other changes do not need one.

If this pull request resolves an issue, end the body with `Fixes #N`.

Use only synthetic or sanitized workbooks and screenshots. Keep private corpus content out of this pull request.
